Beyond the obvious · twice-weekly edit

Unusual London events,
this week.

Discover free and affordable things to do in London this week and weekend, selected for unusual access, local character and a story worth following. Every listing is checked against the official organiser before publication.

Friday 27 November – Saturday 28 November · Last edited 23 November at 15:07

The complete edit

6 verified events
Friday 27 November3 events
Heritage & history Free; optional donation

09:30–17:00

The 544: A Photographic Memorial

Sarah Ketelaars' 544 individual cyanotypes restore presence to unnamed psychiatric patients murdered by the Nazis, shown inside London's specialist museum of mental-health history.

Venue
Bethlem Museum of the Mind
Address
Bethlem Royal Hospital, Monks Orchard Road, Beckenham, BR3 3BX
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Heritage & history Free

12:00–17:00

National Art Library Discovery Day

The V&A opens the National Art Library's reading room and hidden spaces for collection displays, book-making, curator talks and small-capacity behind-the-scenes tours.

Venue
National Art Library, V&A South Kensington
Address
Cromwell Road, London, SW7 2RL
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Community Free

17:00–21:00

Stanley Arts Christmas Market and Lights

South Norwood's Grade II-listed arts centre brings local makers into Stanley Hall, then gathers the neighbourhood outside for its annual tree-lighting ceremony.

Venue
Stanley Arts
Address
12 South Norwood Hill, London, SE25 6AB
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Saturday 28 November3 events
Heritage & history Free

10:00–23:00

London Museum Opens at Smithfield

The city's museum begins a new chapter inside Smithfield's restored Victorian General Market, revealing London collections and the building's market fabric on an unusually late opening day.

Venue
London Museum
Address
General Market, West Smithfield, London, EC1A 9AG
Access
Booking recommended
Check official details ↗
Local culture Free entry; optional paid activities

12:00–17:00

Cody Dock Frost Fair

Cody Dock revives the Thames frost-fair tradition beside the lower Lea with local makers, winter crafts, live music, a children's lantern procession and a new ironwork installation.

Venue
Cody Dock
Address
11c South Crescent, London, E16 4TL
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Art & design Free

17:00–21:00

Wallace Collection Festive Late

Hertford House stays open after hours for pop-up music, collection tours, paper crafts and hands-on armour, with the opulent galleries dressed for winter.

Venue
The Wallace Collection
Address
Hertford House, Manchester Square, London, W1U 3BN
Access
Drop in
